Title: Deploy to Azure Kubernetes Service by using DevOps Projects: Sprint 134 Update

Body.Content:
The Sprint 134 Update of Visual Studio Team Services brings better support for Ruby, Python, and Java languages for build and even more deployment options for release. One of those options is the addition of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) in Azure DevOps Projects to help you get started with containerized applications that are ready for scale. The release gates feature, which has been in preview for the last few months, now becomes generally available to help you automate the control of progressive deployments across environments of a release.

A new version of the Demo Generator is also available to make it easy to demo and learn Visual Studio Team Services by using a rich set of sample data and configuration.

For more information, see the full release notes.
